review_locator: PMID:8948019, Function and signal transduction mediated by the interleukin 3 receptor system in hematopoiesis
primary_title: IL-3 dependent regulation of Bcl-xL gene expression by STAT5 in a bone marrow derived cell line
decision_basis: The review-guided primary shows IL-3-dependent STAT5 signaling in Ba/F3 hematopoietic cells and links dominant-negative STAT5 to loss of IL-3-regulated Bcl-x expression.
limitations_preserved: Promote as an evidence-skipped IL-3-to-STAT5 bridge alongside the existing IL3RA:CSF2RB receptor-complex→STAT5 edge; preserve Ba/F3 context and do not infer a universal IL-3 mechanism or SCI relevance.
